concerns.text: Task T015 mandates a fallback to a 'banded/block-diagonal approximation' if N > 10,000. This violates FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI which explicitly require the construction of a 'full covariance matrix'. The task silently relaxes the requirement to a lower-fidelity approximation without spec authorization.

Task T023 implements a 'stop early if converged' logic with a max of 10,000 steps. This contradicts FR-003 and Constitution Principle VII which mandate 'exactly 100 walkers and 5000 steps' (or more if not converged). The task weakens the rigid configuration discipline required by the constitution.

Task T027-PROACTIVE introduces dynamic 'deterministic random subsample' logic to fit runtime limits. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and FR-006, which require results to be reproducible by re-running code against the *same* data. Dynamic subsampling alters the dataset composition on the fly, breaking reproducibility.

Task T031 hardcodes a `COVARIANCE_INFLATION_FACTOR` default of 2.0. The spec (US-3, SC-003) and plan explicitly mark this value as '[deferred]' to be determined by research. Hardcoding a specific value in the task list prematurely fixes an experimental variable, violating the [deferred] convention and the spec's intent.

Tasks T025-IMP and T026-IMP conflate Injection-Recovery (FR-008) and Null-Simulation (FR-009) into a single file path (`code/robustness/injection.py`). FR-008 and FR-009 are distinct functional requirements with different validation goals (recovery vs. false-positive baseline). Merging them risks failing to implement the distinct logic required for each.
